request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:CATAPULT

layers.text: Change only the little goblin in the cart: a little bigger, with a big round olive green head (#8a952f), two long pointed ears sticking out sideways, big cream eyes with black pupils, a toothy grin and a brown leather cap (#955627); he leans out over the side of the cart holding a small lit match. Nothing sticks out past the cart's right side. Keep everything else the same: the five paper rockets, the dark brown cart and wheels, sticks, rope, fuse spark, black outline and art style.
